g.text: DIGITAL RESEARCH CIRCUIT / RESTRICTED 24 V, 3 mA SOURCES / ARTIFICIAL LOADS ONLY

g.desc: DIGITAL RESEARCH CIRCUIT / RESTRICTED 24 V, 3 mA SOURCES / ARTIFICIAL LOADS ONLY

g.text: Sixteen selectable stimulation contacts, two dedicated monitored returns; command-level routing is not measured continuity or isolation.

g.desc: Sixteen selectable stimulation contacts, two dedicated monitored returns; command-level routing is not measured continuity or isolation.

g.text: RESET_READY low asynchronously clears active bits to zero; outputs remain inhibited until legal COMMIT, fresh readback ACK and deliberate REARM.

g.desc: RESET_READY low asynchronously clears active bits to zero; outputs remain inhibited until legal COMMIT, fresh readback ACK and deliberate REARM.

g.text: Candidate bits may change without changing active addresses. Eight active flip-flops always see raw COMMIT clock; safe D selection loads or holds.

g.desc: Candidate bits may change without changing active addresses. Eight active flip-flops always see raw COMMIT clock; safe D selection loads or holds.

g.text: SRCLR affects only the candidate shift stage. QH_SHIFT is payload cascade, not active-address or analog switch readback. Actual Q bits appear at J6.

g.desc: SRCLR affects only the candidate shift stage. QH_SHIFT is payload cascade, not active-address or analog switch readback. Actual Q bits appear at J6.

g.text: QUIET_SAFE and candidate data must meet physical setup/hold. Gate delay, asynchronous clear, metastability and clock-integrity qualification remain.

g.desc: QUIET_SAFE and candidate data must meet physical setup/hold. Gate delay, asynchronous clear, metastability and clock-integrity qualification remain.
